reactions.name: Synthesis of Syndecan-1 core protein (scaled 1/1000)
reactions.description: Polymerization of amino acids into Syndecan-1 core protein, scaled by 1/1000 for normalization
reactions.equation: 0.035000 L-alanine[r] + 0.010000 L-arginine[r] + 0.005000 L-asparagine[r] + 0.011000 L-aspartate[r] + 0.002000 L-cysteine[r] + 0.013000 L-glutamine[r] + 0.026000 L-glutamate[r] + 0.024000 L-glycine[r] + 0.007000 L-histidine[r] + 0.005000 L-isoleucine[r] + 0.022000 L-leucine[r] + 0.011000 L-lysine[r] + 0.004000 L-methionine[r] + 0.003000 L-phenylalanine[r] + 0.022000 L-proline[r] + 0.017000 L-serine[r] + 0.024000 L-threonine[r] + 0.003000 L-tryptophan[r] + 0.005000 L-tyrosine[r] + 0.012000 L-valine[r] + 1.000000 ATP[r] + 0.750000 H2O[r] --> 0.001 Syndecan1_core_protein[r] + 1.000000 ADP[r] + 1.000000 phosphate[r] + 1.000000 H+[r]
